definitions.explanation: A round bamboo or wooden basket with a slatted bottom used for steaming food over a pot of boiling water. Used both in Japanese cuisine (steamed buns, vegetables, seafood) and in Chinese dim sum.

examples.japanese: {蒸籠|せいろ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{野菜|やさい}→野菜：02265_yasai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{蒸|む}した→蒸す：02307_musu⟧。
examples.english: I steamed vegetables in a bamboo steamer.

examples.japanese: {蒸籠|せいろ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{重|かさ}ねて→重ねる：02039_kasaneru⟧⟦{何|なん}→何〜：03100_nan⟧⟦{種類|しゅるい}→種類：01560_shurui⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{点心|てんしん}→点心：13426_tenshin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{一度|いちど}→一度：01312_ichido⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{蒸|む}せる→蒸す：02307_musu⟧。
examples.english: You can stack the steamers and steam several kinds of dim sum at once.

examples.japanese: {蒸籠|せいろ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{使|つか}った→使う：00473_tsukau⟧⟦{後|あと}→後：09580_ato⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{完全|かんぜん}→完全：01552_kanzen⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{乾|かわ}かさない→乾かす：01931_kawakasu⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦カビ→カビ：07055_kabi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{生|は}え→生える：02392_haeru⟧やすい。
examples.english: If you don't dry the bamboo steamer thoroughly after use, it tends to get mouldy.

notes:
Originally a Chinese cooking implement; now also fully integrated into Japanese kitchens. The kanji {蒸籠|せいろ} is rarely written by hand — the kana spelling せいろ is more common in everyday writing.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {蒸籠|せいろ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{蒸|む}す→蒸す：02307_musu⟧: to steam in a bamboo steamer
- {蒸籠|せいろ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{重|かさ}ねる→重ねる：02039_kasaneru⟧: to stack steamers
- {蒸籠|せいろ}⟦{蒸|む}し→蒸し：14266_mushi⟧: a dish steamed in a bamboo steamer

RELATED USE:
The word also names a soba dish: {蒸籠|せいろ}そば, cold soba noodles served on a bamboo tray — historically the noodles were once steamed, hence the name.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{蒸|む}し{器|き}→蒸し器：08536_mushiki⟧: steamer (general) — metal multi-tiered steamers, not specifically bamboo
